reauth_confirm.title: Renew pairing
reauth_confirm.description: The pairing with **{name}** has ended or is no longer valid. Continue to show a new code and pair the app again. Existing entities and history are kept.

retry.title: Pairing did not complete
retry.description: Select Submit to show a new code. If a code is locked without you having entered it wrongly, someone on your network may be interfering; create a new code.

progress.wait_for_app:
Open iTrend Player on your TV, go to Settings > Home Assistant and enter this address and code:

**Address:** {address}

**Code:** **{code}**

The code is valid for 5 minutes and can only be used once. This window updates by itself as soon as the app has paired.

error.code_expired: The code expired. Please create a new code.
error.code_locked: Code locked after too many wrong attempts. Please create a new code.
error.code_replaced: Another setup window created a new code. Please create a new code here.
error.code_cancelled: The pairing was cancelled. Please create a new code.
error.pairing_blocked: Several codes were locked in a short time. Pairing is paused for about {minutes} minutes.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.setup_failed: The integration could not be started. Check the log.

unpaired_by_app.title: Device ended the pairing
unpaired_by_app.description: {name} ended the pairing from the app. Its key was deleted. Remove the entry, or open it and select Renew pairing to pair the app again.

key_possibly_copied.title: Pairing key possibly copied
key_possibly_copied.description: Messages for {name} arrived with sequence numbers that suggest the same key is used on two devices (for example a restored backup). Remove the entry and pair the TV again.
